confirmedDefectsCorrected: Request URL pathnames are decoded exactly once across guarded SPA/static lookups, preserving generic filesystem semantics.
Explicit nested polymorphic paths hydrate with the concrete target and relation owner, including constructor identity and cached flat-to-nested traversal.
Retrieved observers can invalidate/materialize relations without absence caching suppressing existing reload behavior.
The extra callback getter read introduced in the merged but unreleased candidate was reproduced against the published passing control and corrected before publication.
testedCompatibility: Flat eager records and lazy Model shapes
Visibility scopes, batching and query-count controls
Existing observer dispatch and cache invalidation semantics
Guarded request hooks, HEAD, private-file isolation and traversal rejection
App-owned sources/builds/locks and committed rows during compatible migration

incompletePreviousAttempt.reason: Copied fixture hardcoded the prior receipt version although all four behavior cases and actual 2.2.51 package checks passed. The strict outer version assertion failed and remains intact.

registryPropagation.scope: After the full successful publication workflow, first preflight saw four exact manifests and a starter404; later all five same endpoints returned200 before any profile executed. No publication retry.

releaseFocusedMissingHostEnvironment.scope: Four global setup errors before tests; identical tests then passed with required host environment.

externalWrapperSdkTyping.scope: Compile-only child-stream union correction before any published profile executed; no runtime/assertion/timeout change.

limitsAndRemainingWork: Native Bun asynchronous-pipeline truncation remains unresolved; original strict 64 MiB byte/hash failure receipts are retained.
Mixed HTTP/WebSocket listener abort-drain reporting remains limited; the HTTP-only correction is not a mixed-listener fix.
Public artifact origin is the selected major-version design target, not a shipped public API or production provider.
Native Nginx and Chromium feasibility is pinned/local; complete graph integrity, browser minimums, TLS/cookies, provider, retention and cached-client migration remain review gates.
Twelve compatible cookie/no-tenancy migrations are not major-version, custom-auth-policy, browser cached-client or deployment qualification.
Finite guarded-route typing, actual API/web capability contracts and canonical route/collision/method diagnostics still need a concrete major proposal and compile/HTTP migration proof.
No new major version, prerelease next channel, deprecation deadline or persisted protocol redesign has been accepted or implemented.
Issue257 is closed/completed, but the explicit manual shop adoption hold remains; native SQL retirement timers were not newly qualified.
